_derivation: CONSTRUCTED from every AUTH_2FA_INVALID throw site (undecodable/expired challenge, wrong purpose, flag off, TOTP not enabled, locked, wrong code). NOT a live capture.
_content_type: application/problem+json (ASSUMED: not set explicitly on the ApiException path)
_note: One code covers all 2FA failures, so the UI cannot distinguish an expired challenge from a wrong code. A failed attempt increments totp_failed_count; 5 failures lock the account for 15 minutes. Non-6-digit codes are tried as recovery codes first.
title: Unauthorized
